question: Which of the following is a well-known bronze artefact from the Indus Valley Civilisation, dating to around 2500 BCE?

options.text: Stone seal of unicorn from Lothal

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dancing Girl statue from Mohenjo‑daro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Dancing Girl statue** is a famous **bronze artefact** from the **Indus Valley Civilisation**, specifically from **Mohenjo-daro**, one of the major urban centres of this ancient civilisation.
 
• It dates back to approximately **2500 BCE** and is considered a masterpiece of **Harappan art**.
 
• The statue is about **4 inches tall** and depicts a young girl in a confident, dynamic pose, showcasing the advanced **metalworking skills** of the Harappan people.
